checks.details: Correct sequential fixture passed, injected fault failed, repaired fixture passed.
Icarus 12 compilation and simulation passed with 4631 output checks; all eight transitions covered.

limitations: Development verification does not establish official evaluation correctness.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
Initial state before a synchronous reset is unspecified by the problem and was not constrained by the testbench.
implementation: Four-state Moore FSM; original one-bit ports preserved; synchronous active-high reset to A on positive clock edge; out is asserted only in D; no added latency.
verification: Independent table-based oracle exhausts all 256 eight-bit input sequences from reset, checks every transition, output stability between clock edges, reset from each state, and repeated reset. Bounded timeout and fatal mismatch checks included.
